---
title: plot
subtitle: Compose a layered plot from data, aesthetics, and geom layers.
category: Core
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


`plot` is the entry point of the grammar: it resolves the dataset, wires up
the aesthetic mapping, trains scales against the data, applies coordinate,
facet, theme, and label choices, and dispatches to the internal renderer.
Call it once per figure, passing the layers you want to stack.

## Usage

```typst
plot(
  data: none,
  mapping: none,
  layers: (),
  scales: (),
  coord: none,
  facet: none,
  theme: none,
  labs: none,
  width: 10cm,
  height: 7cm,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `none` | Array of row dictionaries. Each row is a `(column: value, ...)` dict. |
| `mapping` | `none` | Aesthetic mapping built with [`aes`](aes.qmd). Maps column names to visual channels. |
| `layers` | `()` | Array of geom layers (e.g. [`geom-point`](../geoms/geom-point.qmd), [`geom-line`](../geoms/geom-line.qmd)). Drawn in order. |
| `scales` | `()` | Array of scale objects overriding defaults ([`scale-x-continuous`](../scales/scale-x-continuous.qmd), [`scale-colour-viridis-d`](../scales/scale-colour-viridis-d.qmd), etc.). |
| `coord` | `none` | Coordinate system. Defaults to [`coord-cartesian`](../coord/coord-cartesian.qmd) when `none`. |
| `facet` | `none` | Faceting specification built with [`facet-wrap`](../facets/facet-wrap.qmd) or [`facet-grid`](../facets/facet-grid.qmd). |
| `theme` | `none` | Theme object (e.g. [`theme-grey`](../themes/theme-grey.qmd), [`theme-minimal`](../themes/theme-minimal.qmd), [`theme-classic`](../themes/theme-classic.qmd)). Controls non-data ink. |
| `labs` | `none` | Labels dictionary built with [`labs`](../labs/labs.qmd) (title, subtitle, caption, axis titles). |
| `width` | `10cm` | Total plot width, including axes and legends. |
| `height` | `7cm` | Total plot height, including axes and legends. |

## Returns

Typst content block containing the rendered figure.

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/plot-1.svg"
//| width: 12cm
//| height: 7cm
#let mtcars = (
  (mpg: 21.0, wt: 2.620, cyl: "6"),
  (mpg: 22.8, wt: 2.320, cyl: "4"),
  (mpg: 18.7, wt: 3.440, cyl: "8"),
  (mpg: 16.4, wt: 4.070, cyl: "8"),
  (mpg: 33.9, wt: 1.835, cyl: "4"),
)
#plot(
  data: mtcars,
  mapping: aes(x: "wt", y: "mpg", colour: "cyl"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt),),
  labs: labs(title: "Fuel economy vs. weight"),
)
```
